Author: Juvvadi Sridevi

entities.text: Garude Ajay Kumar vs The State Of Telangana
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.1083 of 2025
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of BNSS by the petitioner/accused to quash the proceedings against him in Spl.S.C.No.57 of 2023 on the file of VI Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge at Secunderabad, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 417, 420 of IPC and Section 3(2) (v) of SCs/STs (POA) Act, 2018.

entities.text: Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge at Secunderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioner as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 29.01.2025, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 03.02.2025 and the same is placed on record.
5.
In view of the above, I.A.Nos.3 and 4 of 2025 are allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner/accused in Spl.S.C.No.57 of 2023 on the file of VI Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge at Secunderabad, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge at Secunderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
